zh-TW: 營業利益佔時收資本比率
營業利益占實收資本比率

note.zh-TW: 模板「時收」應為「實收」，顯示修正寫法，模板原文列為別名；是否仍屬現行年報指標待確認（T23），暫標「延伸指標」。
note.en: The template label contains a typo for paid-in; the corrected wording is shown and the original kept as an alias. Whether it is still a current annual report ratio is pending (T23), so it is marked as an extension ratio for now.

definition.zh-TW: 營業利益相對於股東實收資本的比率，只看本業賺回多少本錢。數值越高表示本業的獲利能力越強。
definition.en: Operating profit relative to paid-in capital: how much of the capital the core business earns back. Higher means a more profitable core business.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
